# Third-party source

These files are unmodified copies from
[Space Paranoids](https://github.com/ross-newman/space-paranoids), commit
`0b20315eda8700ce752c85be4ab069a2e50ef1b5`. Only the parts aterminal uses are included.

| Folder | Upstream | Contents |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `softrender/` | `engine/` | Image types, stroke text, bloom, PNG output, parallel rows |
| `adlib/` | `adlib/` | AdLib-style FM synthesizer for key clicks |

Each folder keeps its upstream MIT `LICENSE`.
